A detector predicts four numbers per box.zh: 检测器为每个框预测四个数 — 位置与尺寸 — 并通过惩罚其与真值之差来训练它们。但@@T0@@如何@@T1@@ 惩罚这一差值至关重要。L2 对最差的框耿耿于怀；L1 对每个误差一视同仁，却在零点处有折角；smooth-L1 则兼取二者之长。拖动预测框，观察这三种损失如何争执。
A detector predicts four numbers per box.src: A detector predicts four numbers per box — position and size — and trains them by penalizing the difference from the ground truth. But how you penalize that difference matters. L2 obsesses over the worst box; L1 treats every error the same but has a kink at zero; smooth-L1 blends the two. Drag the predicted box and watch the three losses argue.

@@T0@@约 8 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 目标检测 · 损失函数@@T3@@

A predicted box is a vector $\\hat{\\mat.src:
A predicted box is a vector $\hat{\mathbf{b}}=(x,y,w,h)$ and the target is
      $\mathbf{b}^{*}=(x^{*},y^{*},w^{*},h^{*})$. The regression loss is a sum over the four
      per-coordinate residuals $r_i = \hat{b}_i - b^{*}_i$:

Everything hinges on the shape of the pe.zh: 一切都取决于逐坐标惩罚项 $\ell(r)$ 的形状。三种经典选择如下：
Everything hinges on the shape of the pe.src:
Everything hinges on the shape of the per-coordinate penalty $\ell(r)$. The three
      classic choices:

Move the box, read the loss.src: Move the box, read the loss

The @@T0@@green dashed@@T1@@ box is the.zh: @@T0@@绿色虚线@@T1@@ 框为固定的真值。@@T2@@蓝色@@T3@@ 框为你的预测 — 用滑块移动它。右图绘制了三种逐坐标惩罚项；滑动标记位于当前的 $x$ 方向残差 $r_x$ 处，因此当你把框推离目标时，可以观察每种损失如何响应。
The @@T0@@green dashed@@T1@@ box is the.src: The green dashed box is the fixed ground truth. The blue box is your prediction — move it with the sliders. The right panel plots the three per-coordinate penalties; the sliding marker sits at the current $x$-residual $r_x$, so you can watch each loss respond as you push the box off target.

(a) Predicted vs. ground-truth box. Arro.zh: (a) 预测框与真值框。箭头表示四个残差 $r_x,r_y,r_w,r_h$。
(a) Predicted vs. ground-truth box. Arro.src: (a) Predicted vs. ground-truth box. Arrows show the four residuals $r_x,r_y,r_w,r_h$.

(b) Per-coordinate penalty vs. residual.zh: (b) 逐坐标惩罚项对残差 $r$。圆点标出各曲线上的 $r_x$。
(b) Per-coordinate penalty vs. residual.src: (b) Per-coordinate penalty vs. residual $r$. The dot marks $r_x$ on each curve.

@@T0@@Push the box far off target.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@把框推得远离目标。@@T1@@ L2 的数值呈二次方急剧攀升，而 L1 与 smooth-L1 仅线性增长。现在切换到@@T2@@显示梯度@@T3@@：L2 的梯度是直线 $r$，因此单个错得离谱的框会产生巨大的梯度，淹没所有位置良好的框的更新。这种对离群点的敏感性，正是 smooth-L1 被设计来修正的问题。
@@T0@@Push the box far off target.@@T1@@.src: Push the box far off target. The L2 number rockets up quadratically while L1 and smooth-L1 grow only linearly. Now flip to Show gradients: L2's gradient is the straight line $r$, so a single wildly-wrong box produces a huge gradient that swamps the update for all the well-placed boxes. That outlier sensitivity is exactly what smooth-L1 was designed to fix.

Why smooth-L1 wins for boxes.zh: 为何 smooth-L1 在边界框上胜出

Read the three gradients side by side &m.zh: 将三种梯度并排细读 — 真正训练网络的是梯度：
Read the three gradients side by side &m.src: Read the three gradients side by side — the gradient is what actually trains the network:

@@T0@@L2@@T1@@ has gradient $r$: smooth.zh: @@T0@@L2@@T1@@ 的梯度为 $r$：在目标附近光滑且性质良好，但它@@T2@@无界增长@@T3@@。训练早期一个初始化糟糕的框就可能支配整个批次。
@@T0@@L2@@T1@@ has gradient $r$: smooth.src: L2 has gradient $r$: smooth and well-behaved near the target, but it grows without bound. One badly-initialized box early in training can dominate the batch.

@@T0@@L1@@T1@@ has gradient $\\pm 1$: bo.zh: @@T0@@L1@@T1@@ 的梯度为 $\pm 1$：有界且对离群点稳健，但它从不松劲。即便一个近乎完美的框也持续受到满力度的 $\pm 1$ 推动，而 $r=0$ 处的折角使梯度不连续。
@@T0@@L1@@T1@@ has gradient $\\pm 1$: bo.src: L1 has gradient $\pm 1$: bounded and robust to outliers, but it never eases off. Even a near-perfect box keeps getting a full-strength $\pm 1$ nudge, and the kink at $r=0$ makes the gradient discontinuous.

@@T0@@Smooth-L1@@T1@@ is $r/\\beta$ near.zh: @@T0@@Smooth-L1@@T1@@ 在零附近为 $r/\beta$（如 L2，故能平缓而光滑地穿过原点），在尾部则为 $\pm 1$（如 L1，故离群点无法使其爆炸）。过渡发生在 $|r|=\beta$ 处。
@@T0@@Smooth-L1@@T1@@ is $r/\\beta$ near.src: Smooth-L1 is $r/\beta$ near zero (like L2, so it settles gently and smoothly through the origin) and $\pm 1$ in the tails (like L1, so outliers cannot blow up). The transition happens at $|r|=\beta$.

@@T0@@This is why detectors use it.@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@这正是检测器采用它的原因。@@T1@@ Fast R-CNN 正是出于这一理由引入了 smooth-L1，此后这一模式又被沿用到 Faster R-CNN、SSD 与 RetinaNet。框的目标本身带有噪声，且某些锚框起始位置相距甚远；二次的核心使框接近后优化保持稳定，而线性的尾部则阻止少数极差的框劫持梯度。移动 $\beta$ 即可改变稳健性接替精确性的位置。
@@T0@@This is why detectors use it.@@T1@.src: This is why detectors use it. Fast R-CNN introduced smooth-L1 for exactly this reason, and the pattern carried into Faster R-CNN, SSD, and RetinaNet. Box targets are noisy and some anchors start far away; the quadratic core keeps optimization stable once boxes are close, while the linear tails stop a handful of terrible boxes from hijacking the gradient. Move $\beta$ to shift where robustness takes over from precision.

meta.title: 边界框回归损失
meta.tagline: 在真值框周围拖动预测框，观察 L1、L2 与 smooth-L1 关于“该多在意”的分歧
meta.summary: 目标检测器要回归四个框的数值，而你所选的损失决定了单个位置糟糕的框会受到何种惩罚。用滑块拖动预测框，实时读取 L1、L2（平方）与 smooth-L1；随后切换到函数视图看清缘由：L2 的梯度无界增长，故单个离群框便支配了更新；L1 的梯度是恒定的正负一，但在零点处有折角；而 smooth-L1 在零附近为二次、在尾部为线性 —— 这一稳健的折中由 Fast R-CNN 确立为标准。
highlights: 在固定的真值框上拖动预测框，实时观察四个残差与三种损失的更新。
将 L1、L2 与 smooth-L1 作为残差的函数加以比较，并用一个随框移动而沿各曲线滑动的标记指示当前位置。
切换到梯度视图，观察 L2 的斜率如何无界增长，而 L1 始终固定于正负一。
看清 smooth-L1 恰在过渡点 beta 处由二次交接为线性，并移动 beta 以改变该交接位置。
理解检测器为何使用 smooth-L1：零附近的二次性带来稳定的微调，尾部的线性则带来对离群框的稳健性。
